sentences.text: I found it in Grandpa's notebook.
Forty years ago, he and Mr. Hale were partners.
The same nine on my list.
On the last page, Grandpa wrote: "They will not last.
Take them down before they fall."
So the list is not a job.
Defne read it over my shoulder.
She was quiet for a long time.
Then she asked, "How are your exams going?"
I opened the game on my phone, just to not look at her.
Then I read the ninth address again.
And people still work in it.
